_note:
Per query, ROC AUC is the probability that a randomly chosen positive is ranked above a randomly
chosen negative; neutral targets and the query itself are excluded. Every method returns a ranked
list; targets it does not return are tied below all returned targets (a positive-negative pair
that are both unreturned counts 1/2). Methods that rank only part of the database (prefilter
depth, E-value cut-off, hit lists) are therefore credited 1/2 for every unreturned pair, while
exhaustive aligners rank every target. Seeded methods (RFoldSearch, RFoldSearch-TM): mean over the
tie-breaking seeds.
